supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: pronounced 2D extension beyond the outer ocular corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast characterized by a light-colored muzzle against dark/shadowed periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick lower lip with a visible structural droop in neutral position

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: visible structural anomaly on the upper helix of the right ear

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: large, central depigmented or balding patch on the superior cranial region
other_distinctive_markers: sparse white hairs forming a light beard on the chin and lower muzzle area
